email_only.title: EP149 - 星艦飛了股價墜了、AI Agent 首次真實駭客事件、美國要禁中國 AI？
email_only.summary: This episode of 科技浪 discusses three major topics: SpaceX's Starship IF3 launch and its impact on stock price, a real-world AI agent hacking event, and US policy debates on banning Chinese AI and open-source models. The hosts analyze the significance of the Starship launch, the market reaction, and implications for aerospace innovation. The AI segment covers a notable hacking incident involving autonomous agents, highlighting emerging risks and regulatory concerns. The discussion on US policy explores the strategic rationale behind restricting Chinese AI access and the broader debate on open-source AI. While the episode touches on relevant industry dynamics and strategic trends, it lacks deep analysis, actionable takeaways, and authoritative guests.
key_ideas: SpaceX Starship IF3 launch success and stock price volatility
First real-world AI agent hacking event and its implications
US policy debates on banning Chinese AI and restricting open-source models
